role: Output side of the live-workout coach: owned by WorkoutRecorder, it is fed a WorkoutAIContext each recorder tick, runs the rule-based WorkoutTriggerEngine plus the mile-marker, turn-alert and turn-marker engines, and delivers what they produce: a .haptic or urgent trigger event plays the alert haptic (phone, plus a wrist haptic sent to the Watch), a .spoken or urgent .haptic event and the mile-marker and route lines go to the shared VoiceConversationController's handleTrigger (nothing is said while no conversation is set; route lines are marked so a queued one is replaced and expires). Also holds the in-session mute (which purges queued trigger lines) and exposes the app-language voice helper used by other TTS paths. CoachAlertHaptic is the phone half of the alert haptic.
types: WorkoutVoiceCoach: class (@Observable @MainActor final) — workout coach output, engine state holder, mute toggle
CoachAlertHaptic: enum — the phone's alert haptic (notification generator in the foreground, system vibration in the background)
state: mem:WorkoutVoiceCoach.isMuted (observable, toggled by FitnessRecordingView:280; didSet purges queued spoken trigger lines on mute)
mem:WorkoutVoiceCoach.watchBridge (private weak WatchConnectivityBridge; captured weakly by the default alert-haptic closure)
mem:WorkoutVoiceCoach.playAlertHaptic (private let closure; phone + Watch haptic by default, injectable for tests)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: isMuted=false, hasAnnouncedSubsystem=false, fresh MileMarkerState/TurnAlertState/TurnMarkerState, routeEngagedAt=nil. static ambientFixMaxAgeSec=10. The coach has no synthesizer of its own. Imports AudioToolbox and UIKit for CoachAlertHaptic.

units.does: In-session mute flag, toggled by the recording UI. On a change from unmuted to muted, its didSet asks the conversation to discard the spoken trigger lines still queued (discardPendingSpokenTriggers), so nothing the coach handed over before the tap plays after it.

branches.effect: purge queued spoken triggers; otherwise nothing

units.does: Stores the given engine (or a fresh default WorkoutTriggerEngine) and the weak Watch bridge, and the alert-haptic closure: the given one, else a default that plays CoachAlertHaptic.playOnPhone(urgent:) and asks the bridge (held weakly) to send the Watch a coach-alert haptic.
units.entry: Constructed by WorkoutRecorder.swift:423 with the shared Watch bridge; tests pass an engine and an alertHaptic recorder.

branches.effect: a default-rule WorkoutTriggerEngine is built
the default closure (phone haptic + Watch coach-alert message through the weak bridge; nothing sent once the bridge is gone) is stored

units.does: Per-recorder-tick entry (WorkoutRecorder+Ticker.swift:843): reads current UserSettings; canAlert = coachAlertsEnabled && !isMuted; always runs the trigger engine with canAlert (.silent rules record even when muted; a .spoken or .haptic rule doesn't fire while it can't be delivered), dispatches its events only when canAlert, always runs the mile-marker engine (it announces only when enabled and unmuted), and runs the route engines if either turn setting is on.
units.entry: Called once per recorder tick from WorkoutRecorder+Ticker.swift:843 (app code, not a framework trigger).

branches.effect: true → every event from engine.evaluate is passed to dispatch(event:); false → only .silent events fired (recorded in engine history), and they are not dispatched.
dispatch each in order; empty array → nothing.
true → tickRouteEngines; false → route engines skipped, ActiveRouteSession step index is not advanced by the coach.

units.does: Runs WorkoutMileMarkerEngine.evaluate with the current interval and units every tick and stores the next state; only when enableMileMarkerNotifications is on, the coach is unmuted, a payload fired and a conversation is set does it render the split line and send it to conversation.handleTrigger (routine urgency).
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite, legacy standard-suite fallback)

branches.cond: notifications on, !isMuted, payload fired and conversation set
branches.effect: false → return after saving state (marker silently consumed); true → render and handleTrigger(message:) with default .routine urgency (queued if user/AI busy).

units.does: Reads the engaged route snapshot and a position fix; if both exist, ActiveRouteSession.currentStep(for:) yields a step (which also advances the session's step index) and a second snapshot shows the same engagedAt (no route swap between the two locked reads), resets route-engine state on a new route, then runs the turn-alert engine and/or the turn-marker engine per settings and announces any rendered payload.
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite, legacy standard-suite fallback)

branches.cond: snapshot() non-nil, routeFix non-nil, currentStep(for:) non-nil, and snapshot()?.engagedAt unchanged
branches.effect: any fails → return; no engine runs this tick (a swapped route is read whole next tick). All hold → continue.
true → tickTurnAlert; false → turn-alert engine skipped.
true → TurnMarkerEngine.evaluate, store nextState, maybe announce; false → skipped.
true → announceRouteLine(rendered text); false → nothing spoken.

units.does: Computes whether the step is the route's final step, runs TurnAlertEngine.evaluate with the stored state, stores the next state, and announces the rendered alert when a payload fires.

branches.effect: true → announceRouteLine(TurnAlertFormatter.render(...)); false → nothing spoken.

units.does: Returns a CLLocation for route distance math: the workout context's own lat/lon if both present, else AmbientLocationService.cachedLocation no older than 10 s (or nil).

branches.effect: true → CLLocation from them (no accuracy/timestamp carried); false → ambient cached fix ≤10 s old, or nil which makes tickRouteEngines return.

units.does: If the engaged route's engagedAt differs from the remembered one, records it and resets turnAlertState and turnMarkerState to fresh values.

branches.effect: true → return (same route, state kept); false (first route or a new one) → store date and reset both route-engine states.

units.does: Announces one route line: drops it if muted, empty or no conversation is set, else routes it to conversation.handleTrigger (routine) marked as a route line, so a queued one is replaced by a newer route line and expires before it can play after the turn.

branches.effect: false → return silently (line lost; engine state already advanced); true → handleTrigger(message:isRouteLine: true), urgency .routine.

units.does: Start-of-workout reset (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift:299): resets the trigger engine's cooldowns/history, re-arms the preamble, and replaces mile-marker, turn-alert and turn-marker state with fresh values and clears routeEngagedAt. Does not touch isMuted or audio.

Delivers one fired trigger-engine event: a .haptic or urgent event first plays the alert haptic (urgent flag passed; phone + Watch by default). Then a .spoken event, or an urgent .haptic one (the strap drop), is spoken through dispatchSpoken — unless it is routine and the AI conversation is in flight, when it is logged and not spoken (its haptic has already played). .silent and routine .haptic events say nothing.
units.entry: Called from tick(context:) only while alerts can be delivered; tests call it directly.

branches.effect: playAlertHaptic(urgent)
false (.silent, routine .haptic) → return with nothing spoken
true → debugLog and return; the line is not spoken or queued (cooldown already consumed). false → dispatchSpoken(event).

units.does: With a conversation set: builds the spoken text ("Coach alert — " prefix, plus the "Coach here." preamble on first line/preempt) and sends it to conversation.handleTrigger with the event's urgency mapped to .urgent/.routine. Without one: says nothing.

branches.effect: return without speaking
.urgent → TriggerUrgency.urgent; anything else → .routine. handleTrigger: routine queues if user/AI busy; urgent preempts and copies partial transcript to clipboard.

units.does: Prepends AssistantSubsystem.workoutVoiceCoach.voiceAnnouncement ("Coach here.") to the body the first time per session, or whenever the coach is about to preempt an in-flight AI conversation, and marks the preamble as said.

branches.effect: no conversation → false (no preempt).
false (already announced and AI idle) → body unchanged; true → set flag and return preamble + " " + body.

units.does: Static: returns message prefixed with the localized "Coach alert — ". Only trigger-engine alerts carry it (its one caller is dispatchSpoken).

units.does: Plays the phone half of a coach alert's haptic: with the app active, the pre-warmed WorkoutStartCue.notificationFeedback generator (.error for urgent, .warning otherwise); in the background, where a feedback generator plays nothing, the system vibration (kSystemSoundID_Vibrate).
units.entry: Called by WorkoutVoiceCoach's default alert-haptic closure (dispatch(event:)).

branches.effect: system vibration and return
